urls.description: Visualizing native RNA dynamics in living plant cells at single transcript resolution is limited by high background fluorescence. This study develops a high signal-to-noise CRISPR-dCas13X imaging platform that overcomes this barrier and provides insights into mRNA trafficking dynamics.
urls.title: A binding-activated CRISPR/dCas13X imaging system enables precise RNA tracking in plants
